stories.headline: Meta's Black Friday sale: 25% off Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2, 15% off Quest 3S
stories.subtitle: Meta's Black Friday sale runs Nov 20–30: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 and Oakley HSTN are 25% off, Vanguard and select Meta Glasses 15% off, and Quest 3S is 15% off from $296.99. Note for customers: Meta Ray-Ban Display and Gen 3 are excluded.

stories.headline: Rent and buy 3D movies on Meta Quest, including Billie Eilish's concert film
stories.subtitle: Quest owners in the US can now rent and buy 3D movies in the TV app on Quest 3 and 3S, including Billie Eilish's HIT ME HARD AND SOFT concert film. With Disney+ 3D streaming already live, 3D on Quest is becoming a real selling point.

stories.headline: Quest 3S and Xbox Nano Controller bundle lands at $399.98
stories.subtitle: Meta bundles the Quest 3S 128GB with an Xbox Nano controller for $399.98, including two months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and two months of Meta Horizon+. A ready-made gift for gamers who want console play on the go.

stories.headline: Mapbox powers hands-free cycling navigation on Ray-Ban Display
stories.subtitle: Mapbox now powers hands-free cycling navigation on Meta Ray-Ban Display: turn-by-turn directions appear in the lens, with spoken guidance and automatic rerouting. It's Display-only — the feature needs the in-lens screen.

stories.headline: Meta Lab opens its first Chicago location
stories.subtitle: Meta's first Midwest store is coming to Rush Street in Chicago, bringing hands-on demos of the Display glasses and the rest of the lineup to the Windy City just in time for the holidays — a new flagship shoppers may ask about.
